purpose: Teach: 付着/印鑑/コンペ/足場/自粛/増減/連覇/鉄人

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 書類に、本気で、絶対、汚れ、絶対、付着しないよう、絶対、丁寧に、扱いましょうね
lines.en: Let's handle the documents carefully—no stains, no smudges, nothing that might damage them.
lines.style: Crisp, efficient opening. Professional but approachable. Sets a clear standard without sternness. Slight lift at the end, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。書類、本気で、絶対、印鑑、絶対、確認してから、絶対、提出しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm checking the seals thoroughly before submission every time, and I really appreciate your trust.
lines.style: Steady, reliable tone. Slight emphasis on the verification step—showing competence. Warm closing on the gratitude, genuine without over-performing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界コンペ、本気で、絶対、お客様、絶対、楽しんでくださる、企画、絶対、進めましょうね
lines.en: For the industry competition, let's design something that really excites our clients and moves it forward with energy.
lines.style: Purposeful, energized. Forward momentum in the phrasing. Leans slightly into 'excites'—showing conviction. Collaborative tone, not directive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。建設現場の足場、本気で、絶対、安全管理、絶対、確認、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. I'm verifying the construction site scaffolding safety protocols thoroughly each time, and I'm committed to that.
lines.style: Measured, thorough. Slight pause before 'safety protocols'—emphasis on what matters. Solid, reassuring delivery. Committed without sounding strained.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界、本気で、絶対、自粛ムード、絶対、続いていますね、本気で、絶対、当社、絶対、対応、絶対、進めましょう、本気で、本気、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: The industry's still cautious, and we need to stay ahead of that—let's keep responding smartly and stay flexible.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly weighted. Acknowledges the reality without dwelling. Shift to lighter, more forward-looking tone on 'stay flexible'—rallying.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。利益の増減、本気で、絶対、毎週、絶対、報告いたしてまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep you updated on profit movements week by week—that's what matters most right now.
lines.style: Steady, reliable. Clinical clarity on the facts. Slight warmth underneath—showing understanding of why this matters. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界連覇、本気で、絶対、目指して、絶対、頑張りましょうね、本気で、絶対、社員、皆、本気で、絶対、頑張ろう、本気で、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Let's aim for industry leadership—everyone giving their absolute best. That's what we're here to do together.
lines.style: Inspiring but grounded. Builds toward the final statement with quiet intensity. Inclusive 'together'—not demanding from above. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員に、本気で、絶対、鉄人並みの、絶対、努力、絶対、お願いしておりますよ、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm asking the team to bring that level of dedication—ironman-level effort—and I'm grateful they're answering that call.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly awed. Pauses before 'ironman-level'—weight of what's being asked. Closes warm on the gratitude, acknowledging the human cost.
